market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Iran escalation keeps oil elevated, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. BOJ decision adds FX volatility. AI names provide relative strength but broader market faces headwinds from inflation fears and Goldman's lower-return warning. Expect 5-8% VIX spike potential.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI/tech structural growth but constrained by energy inflation and geopolitical risk. If Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and rate pressure eases. AI capex cycle supports 12-18 month earnings growth in semis and software. K-shaped consumer split persists.
